query: Prepare a one-page briefing for a meeting with Infosys on 17 November 2026. Cover what changed in the last 30 days (news, launches, hires, deals), cite a source URL for every fact, and end with three open questions to ask.
briefing:
# Pre-Meeting Briefing: Infosys, 17 November 2026

**Window:** 18 October to 17 November 2026. Sources are limited to the search results provided.

**Caution on the acquisition item:** A 15 November report says "the company" agreed to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4 billion, with closing expected next quarter. The report does not name the target, so I could not confirm that it refers to Infosys. Verify before raising it. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)

## Deals and Corporate Actions
- Reported agreement to be acquired by Globex Corporation for $9.4B, per people familiar with the matter; target not named in the source. (https://wire-briefs.example/deals/acquisition-announced)
- Interim dividend of Rs 26 per share, up 13% from Rs 23 a year earlier. Record date 3 November; payment 11 November. (https://indiantelevision.com/mam/infosys-cuts-fy27-growth-outlook-despite-strong-ai-revenue-and-deal-wins)

## Financial Outlook
- Infosys lowered its FY27 revenue growth outlook despite strong AI revenue and deal wins; operating margins were reported as steady. (https://indiantelevision.com/mam/infosys-cuts-fy27-growth-outlook-despite-strong-ai-revenue-and-deal-wins)
- Shares slid over 2% on 2 November as the Hyderabad campus expansion failed to lift sentiment. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)

## Facilities and Launches
- Hyderabad campus inaugurated on 2 November, designed for banking, retail, life sciences and manufacturing clients, with radiant cooling and rainwater harvesting. Attended by CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)
- Management held non-deal roadshows in London and Edinburgh, 2–4 November, with CFO Jayesh Sanghrajka and Head of IR Sandeep Mahindroo. (https://scanx.trade/stock-market-news/companies/infosys-hold-investor-roadshows-london-edinburgh-november/54668108)
- No product launches found in the results.

## Workforce and Hiring
- Infosys employs over 325,000 people across 59 countries. (https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/infosys-shares-slide-over-2-hyderabad-campus-expansion-fails-to-lift-sentiment/article71655856.ece)
- The US suspended eight technology firms, including Infosys, from permanent hiring of skilled international workers through a widely used visa pathway. (https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj34j7dk771o)
- A Business Standard report citing PERM Tracker found no Infosys records for 2025–26. (https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cqj34j7dk771o)

## Legal and Regulatory
- Infosys said it is in talks with the US Department of Justice over how it classified certain H-1B employees in immigration filings. It said it cannot predict the outcome. (https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/technology/tech-news/infosys-filing-to-sec-facing-investigation-from-department-of-justice-on-classification-of-h-1b-visa-employees-in-immigration-documents/articleshow/135252907.cms)

*Excluded: a company profile with an M&A entry dated March 2026 (outside the window; undated profile), and several results referring to the "Infosys Theater" at Madison Square Garden, which is unrelated.*

## Open Questions
1. Can you confirm whether the Globex Corporation agreement involves Infosys, and what it means for the timing and scope of our discussions?
2. What is driving the cut to the FY27 revenue growth outlook, and how do you expect margins to hold through the rest of the year?
3. What is the status of the DOJ H-1B investigation and the PERM hiring suspension, and how might they affect your US hiring and delivery capacity?
